$comment: Proposed documentation-only overlay. Not part of the frozen pack; select a role explicitly. Descriptions do not add validation constraints.

object.description: Select filesystem entries and collect their metadata for comparison.

filepath.description: Full path of the selected entry.

filename.description: Entry name within the selected directory; null selects the directory itself.

filesystem.description: Filesystem scope: all, local, or the starting filesystem (same).

traversal.description: Controls recursive searching through directories and symbolic links.

max_depth.description: Maximum downward recursion depth; 0 includes only the starting directory.

recurse.description: Entry types to follow during recursion.

field_meanings.description: Permission bits do not establish effective access; link/target metadata, cycle handling and mount classification are not yet specified.

full_path.description: Full path of the collected entry.

directory.description: Directory component of the collected path.

name.description: Entry name without the directory; directory-only representation is not yet specified.

type.description: Kind of filesystem entry; value labels are not yet specified.

owner_uid.description: Numeric user ID of the owner.

owner_gid.description: Numeric group ID of the owning group.

size.description: File size; unit is not yet specified.

access_time.description: Last data-access time; unit and resolution are not yet specified.

change_time.description: Last inode-status change, not creation time; unit and resolution are not yet specified.

modify_time.description: Last content-modification time; unit and resolution are not yet specified.

owner_read.description: Whether the owner-read permission bit is set.

owner_write.description: Whether the owner-write permission bit is set.

owner_execute.description: Whether the owner-execute/search permission bit is set.

group_read.description: Whether the group-read permission bit is set.

group_write.description: Whether the group-write permission bit is set.

group_execute.description: Whether the group-execute/search permission bit is set.

other_read.description: Whether the other-read permission bit is set.

other_write.description: Whether the other-write permission bit is set.

other_execute.description: Whether the other-execute/search permission bit is set.

has_extended_acl.description: Whether ACL permissions differ from standard UNIX permissions; unsupported-ACL handling is not yet specified.

item.description: Nonexistent Items are omitted; collection absence/errors and field statuses remain separate, with detailed error propagation not yet specified.

require.description: Compare the collected fields using their declared datatypes and the shared Item/field cardinality rules.

item_requirement.description: Independent requirements for the number of selected Items and the number satisfying the comparison.

items_satisfying.description: Required cardinality of Items satisfying the comparison.

field_requirement.description: Explicit shared values_found/values_matching pair; a closer complete pair overrides it without runtime defaults.

fields.description: One complete condition; distinct field predicates are combined with logical AND.
